paper_title: An analysis of vaccine-related sentiments from development to deployment   of COVID-19 vaccines
caption: : Polarity scores for Australia
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the distribution of polarity scores in Australia. The x-axis represents polarity scores on a linear scale, ranging from -1.0 to 0.6, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis represents counts on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 140,000, with tick labels at intervals of 20,000. The plot features a single blue line with circular markers, which starts at approximately 2,000 counts at a polarity score of -1.0, remains relatively stable until around -0.6, then increases to around 10,000 counts at -0.4, followed by a more pronounced increase to around 90,000 counts at -0.2, peaks at approximately 134,000 counts at 0.0, declines to around 60,000 counts at 0.2, and further decreases to around 10,000 counts at 0.6.
